_readme: MCP servers the Nazar investigator can use. Same shape as Claude Desktop / Cursor (mcpServers), so any server's config can be pasted here.
stdio server: command + args (+ env). Remote server: url (+ headers). ${VAR} is filled from .env; a server whose variable is empty is skipped ('needs a key').
A tool runs on its own ONLY if the server marks it read-only or it is listed in auto_approve. Everything else is queued for the owner's approval.
Extra keys: enabled (false = off), tools (allow-list of tool names), auto_approve, require_approval, description.
Provided variables: NAZAR_DATA_DIR, NAZAR_EXPORT_DIR, NAZAR_REPO. Never put a secret in this file - reference it as ${NAME}.

toolbox.description: Weather for a place and day, case notes in the export folder, messages to the owner's Telegram / Slack / Discord (ships with Nazar)

files.description: Full file tools for Nazar's export folder only. Needs Node 24+ (the toolbox already saves notes without it)

memory.description: Long-term notes about this site (opening hours, usual deliveries, what the owner called normal)

thinking.description: A scratchpad for step-by-step reasoning on hard cases

brave.description: Web search (local news, holidays, events near the site)

notion.description: The owner's Notion workspace (incident log, shift notes)

github.description: GitHub issues (for example a ticket for a camera that keeps going offline)

home-assistant.description: Smart home / shop: lights, sirens, door sensors (every switch asks the owner first)

browser.description: A headless browser for pages that need one (heavy: about 300 MB of RAM)
